summary: Подложка-3: таблица choros.app_timer (FORCE RLS, partial-индекс), двухфазный tenant-scoped dispatcher (SECURITY DEFINER next_due_buckets + SET LOCAL fetchAndFire с SKIP LOCKED), метрика timer.lag в GET /health, ops-каталог timer_stats.
